title: When you tell youth don't own your data, don't control where you publish you are setting them up for world where all profit has already been extracted
summary: When you tell youth don't own your data, don't control where you publish you are setting them up for world where all profit has already been extracted and will never trickle down to the artists centered in marginalized communities
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: When you tell youth don't own your data, don't control where you publish you are setting them up for world where all profit has already been extracted and will never trickle down to the artists centered in marginalized communities
